title: Chromium-activated phosphors: from theory to applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1954-1998
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00957J, Review Article
Shengqiang Liu, Leipeng Li, Bing Chen, Quanlin Liu, Feng Wang
This review summarizes the theoretical basis, spectral design principle, and experimental methodologies for constructing chromium-activated NIR phosphors with desired optical properties for photonic and biomedical applications.
